title: Bridging the Data Gap: Source-Informed Task-Space Transport for Few-Shot Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.31323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many deployments require a model to move rapidly from a data-rich source to a related target observed only sparsely. This is especially consequential where target data are difficult to collect, as in healthcare settings with persistent population or acquisition imbalances. Retraining or fine-tuning a high-capacity generator for every target is costly and can be statistically unreliable when target data are scarce. We introduce Meta-Diff, which instead learns a recurring source--target relation once in a compact task space. A shared encoder maps each distribution to a low-dimensional coordinate; a learned relation transports a new source coordinate to its predicted target, and a shared diffusion backbone generates from that prediction without target-specific retraining. translated_title: 弥合数据鸿沟：面向少样本扩散的源信息任务空间传输
translated_abstract: 许多实际部署场景要求模型能够快速地从数据丰富的源域迁移到仅有稀疏观测的相关目标域。当目标数据难以收集时，这一问题尤为突出，例如在存在持续人群或采集不平衡的医疗场景中。为每个目标域重新训练或微调高容量生成器代价高昂，且当目标数据稀缺时在统计上可能不可靠。我们提出 Meta-Diff，它转而在一个紧凑的任务空间中一次性学习反复出现的源-目标关系：一个共享编码器将每个分布映射为低维坐标；一个学习到的关系将新的源坐标传输到其预测的目标坐标，随后共享的扩散主干直接从该预测进行生成，无需针对特定目标进行再训练。受控的高斯混合实验揭示了该方法生效的条件：任务身份必须在表示中得以保留，关系必须能够在不同任务间泛化，并且源-
tldr: 提出 Meta-Diff，通过在紧凑任务空间中一次性学习可复用的源-目标关系，使共享扩散主干无需针对每个目标域再训练即可从稀疏目标数据快速生成，尤其适用于医疗等目标数据难以获取的场景。
en_tdlr: Meta-Diff learns a reusable source-to-target relation once in a compact task space, enabling a shared diffusion backbone to generate for new sparsely-observed target domains without costly target-specific retraining.
